calculation.coordinate_convention: Within the open unit-square chart where the periodized cutoff has only its zero translate, write Cx(X)=closedCutoff(a,b,c,d)(X), Cy(Y)=closedCutoff(a',b',c',d')(Y). For the canonical aligned separable choice χ_*(X,Y)=Cx(X)Cy(Y), not an assertion that the manuscript uniquely selects this χ_*.

calculation.nonidentity_for_shared_cutoff: The smooth cutoff Cx changes from zero to one across its left collar, so its derivative is nonzero at some collar point by the mean value theorem. Choosing Y in the Cy=1 plateau gives a nonzero difference. Thus identifying χ_* with the same separable Lean cutoff does NOT yield global extensional equality of the clock fields.
calculation.common_properties: Both are smooth, compactly supported in the chart and periodicized; both equal 1 on their respective protected plateaus and have zero torus mean by being X-derivatives of compactly supported/periodized potentials. Those properties are sufficient for the source's tracked-corridor clock argument, but not a proof of full field identity.
calculation.limitations: The source leaves χ_* specified by qualitative support/plateau conditions and a rational-margin recipe rather than an exact Lean term. The calculation refutes only the naive same-cutoff substitution, not every possible χ_* or an observational equivalence theorem. No exact source planar V to normalizedHamiltonian equality is inferred.
